description: This file defines the Java class BooleanVariable, representing a boolean variable in a code generation context. It extends the BaseVariable class and provides implementations for methods related to encoding/decoding JSON, C types, and Java types specific to boolean variables. The class is part of a code generation utility related to IPC (Inter-Process Communication) and JSON handling.

classes.name: BooleanVariable
classes.description: Represents a boolean variable, extending BaseVariable, with methods to encode/decode JSON and native code, and to provide type information.

methods.name: BooleanVariable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the BooleanVariable with an ICBoolVariable bean.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Resolves references; in this class, it does nothing as there are no references to resolve.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Returns true indicating this variable is of boolean type.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C language type 'bool' for this variable.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type 'boolean' for this variable.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Provides the JSON key used for this boolean variable based on template mappings.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to encode the boolean value into JSON using cJSON library.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to decode the boolean value from JSON using cJSON library.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code to encode the boolean variable into a JSON object.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code to decode the boolean value from a JSON object.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns the Java IPC object type 'BooleanIPC' associated with this variable.
